Full expert replay remains blocked by method-pattern target-scope binding; no method-fidelity score or predictive-validity result is reported.
wording_ceiling: The accepted source-bounded reconstruction probe makes 11/24 Wang cases eligible for a later full-chart materialization step; 13 remain withheld. It does not claim completed full charts, full expert replay or predictive validity.
